force_bootcmd_tailcall.meaning: replace jr t9 (setenv tailcall) with jr ra after ra/gp/s0 restore
force_bootcmd_tailcall.risk: boot-critical; hardware validated only for the exact byte-exact sector path
force_bootcmd_tailcall.validated_runtime_result: saved bootcmd persists across saveenv and reset

firmware_recovery_branch.meaning: replace bgez v0 with unconditional branch past invalid-firmware do_http; active-low do_download path is earlier and preserved
firmware_recovery_branch.risk: boot-critical; hardware validated only for the exact selective branch replacement
firmware_recovery_branch.validated_runtime_result: released-button startup boots OpenWrt; held button still enters Sercomm download

stock_bootcmd_string.risk: medium; inside vendor updateable upper region but still boot-critical

setenv_wrapper_got.meaning: GOT target used by both ethact and bootcmd assignments
